name: Admin Optimizer
author: Binsaifullah

sections.description:
Admin Optimizer gives you complete control over your WordPress dashboard. From interface customization to security hardening and performance boosting, everything is included in this free plugin.

No Pro Version Required! We believe in providing a complete experience. All powerful features are unlocked and available for free.

Core Features

Custom Login URL
Customize the login URL to make it more secure and user-friendly.

Admin Menu Editor
Sort, rename, and hide admin menu items to make it more user-friendly.

Interface Control
Customize the admin bar, footer, and remove clutter. Hide unwanted notices and create a cleaner workspace.

Login Styler
Completely customize the WordPress login page. Change the logo, background, colors, and add custom CSS to match your brand.

Speed Boost
Improve your site’s performance by controlling the Heartbeat API, limiting post revisions, disabling emojis/embeds, and removing query strings from static resources.

Secure Guard
Harden your WordPress security. Disable XML-RPC, file editing, and hide the WordPress version to prevent vulnerabilities.

Content Tool
Enhance your content workflow. Duplicate posts/pages with one click, enable SVG uploads, and see featured images directly in the post list.

Code Snippets
Easily add custom header/footer scripts and CSS/JS without editing theme files.

Feature Toggle
Disable unused WordPress features like Gutenberg or Comments globally to streamline your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the admin-menu-optimizer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the ‘Admin Optimizer’ menu to configure your settings
sections.faq:
Is there a Pro version?

No, Admin Optimizer includes all features in the free version.

Will this slow down my site?

No, Admin Optimizer is designed to improve performance. You can disable features you don’t use.
